description: This is a source file for a Flutter app, defining a stateful widget 'Home' that serves as the home screen of the task management application. It manages and displays a list of custom task lists, provides navigation to various screens such as 'My Day', 'Add Custom List', and individual list screens, and incorporates UI elements like AppBar, buttons, and a ListView.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main home screen of the task app, providing navigation to different task views and displaying a list of custom lists.

classes.name: _HomeState
classes.description: State class managing the data and UI for the Home widget, including list fetching, building UI components, and handling navigation.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, setting up necessary data by calling 'refreshNotes'.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes (task lists) from the database asynchronously and updates the UI state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the home screen, including app bar, navigation tiles, and list of task lists.
